title: App session in brain run
why: Signed-in pages answered 503 in brain run when the app session held its own fields, while brain start answered 200.
changelog: `brain run` accepts an app session (`BRAIN_BACKEND_SESSION=app`) of any shape instead of answering 503 on every view with a `load`; the log keeps the cause of a 503; a leftover backend cookie no longer reaches the backend in development
